investigation.title: Remote Agent Swarm Gateway 502 — All Remote-Agent Checks Failing via Unreachable ELB Endpoint
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-29T03:22Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2) was unreachable when POST /api/agents was called. Because the failure is upstream of agent creation, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and all contract assertions remain unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB endpoint that backs POST /api/agents for remote agent provisioning — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production API returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning: error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every remote-agent check attempted. Because the failure occurs before the agent creation response is received, no evidence fields can be populated and the expected-output contract cannot be satisfied. This is localized to the swarm gateway dependency of the remote-agents feature in the production-api runtime environment; no evidence of a broader platform outage or user-traffic incident is present in the supplied packet.

Both required contract assertions therefore failed. No code defect is indicated; the failure is entirely attributable to the depleted API credit balance on the OpenAI account used by the eval environment.
